BiblicalUsage: Piltai is named once, in Nehemiah 12:17, as the priest who represented the house of Moadiah among the exiles who returned with Zerubbabel. He stood for his father's house in the restored temple service.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe faithfulness in a small post, named once, is still faithfulness God records.
